goal.objective: After authentic relay Node-KV continuity, observe one exact non-sensitive DEVICE<->KV InTr request/response over the existing deployment-local sovereign runtime and preserve reconstructable canonical evidence.
success_predicates: Parent SHWP-STEGOS-RELAY-NODE-KV-CONTINUITY-001 receipt is authentic COMPLETED RELAY_NODE_KV_CONTINUITY_VERIFIED.
Exact request bytes traverse a bounded deployment-local TCP carrier from DEVICE to the KV boundary receiver.
The receiver binds the request to the authentic parent Node-KV continuity identity and issues a canonical DEVICE->KV InTr receipt only after receiving the bytes.
The merged continuity-vault-kit KVInterlockRuntime consumes the verified envelope and receipt reference.
Exact response bytes traverse the carrier from KV to DEVICE with a canonical chained KV->DEVICE receipt.
Durable receipt readback and reconstruction preserve exact request/response/receipt identities.
No personal data, credential, provider operation, canonical KV mutation, route authority, or execution authority is created.
failure_predicates: Hosted CI or fixture evidence substitutes for deployment-local byte transport.
The worker fabricates a VERIFIED boundary without authentic parent Node-KV continuity evidence.
A second runtime owner, endpoint authority, scheduler, HeartBeat, credential path, or transport broker is created.
GitHub token or NON-TV/TVC secret becomes runtime authority.
HIL or G18 completion is treated as a prerequisite or their claim/fence is consumed.
A transport receipt is emitted before the receiver has received and validated the corresponding bytes.
